headline: Security Procedures Triggered Following Note On Air India Flight
seoTitle: Security Alert On Air India Flight In Kolkata
metaDescription: Security protocols were activated after a note claiming a hijacking threat was discovered on a Mumbai-bound Air India flight in Kolkata.
aiSummaryBullets: A note threatening a hijacking was found in the washroom of an Air India aircraft before its scheduled departure.
The flight, which was preparing to travel from Kolkata to Mumbai, was moved to an isolation bay for safety.
All passengers were deboarded so that security officials could conduct a comprehensive inspection of the plane.
aiContextParagraph: On November 11, 2026, aviation security protocols were initiated at the Kolkata airport following the discovery of a threatening note on an Air India flight destined for Mumbai. According to reports from the Times of India and The Hindu, the note was found in the aircraft's washroom shortly before the flight was scheduled to take off at 11:10 a.m. The discovery of the message, which explicitly mentioned a hijacking threat, prompted authorities to immediately relocate the plane to a secure isolation bay. As a standard safety measure, all individuals on board were removed from the vessel. Security personnel and relevant authorities subsequently carried out a thorough check of the aircraft to ensure no genuine danger existed. This incident highlights the rigorous response measures taken by Indian aviation security in reaction to potential threats against passenger flights.
whyItIsViral: The incident is trending due to the immediate security response protocols involving a commercial airline, which was reported by multiple major news outlets.
